handoff.text: REJECT (r2, agent-0efe). Zoom fix itself is good: drawnColumnMax math right for Chromium and WebKit branch (k=zoom scales both paper and column rects; drawnEdges intact); vitest 8/8; fresh build full floating.spec 35/35 (port 1927); sweep cont75/100/125/150 + page75/125 + all card sweeps except page100: no overlap, no up/down flap, tight gap exactly 16 (cont125 1240/1300, cont150 1400). Fixed widen/toast checks pass in page AND continuous view (panel at 1000 -> 1600 shows card without click; toast clear of card; toast clear of research panel). NEW DEFECT, page view 100%, 1600x800: card sweep page100 (Research opened at 940 -> panel, widen 940..1400 -> 1600) shows the citation card OVER the sheet: card 1226-1584 vs .editor-paper 527-1343 (117 px overlap). Probe (node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui6-rev-t229b/probe.log, 20 samples over 4 s at a FIXED 1600 window after 1400): it oscillates forever between A = sidebar floating + research aside docked (sheet 196-1012, ws 0-1207) and B = sidebar docked + card shown (sheet 527-1343, card overlapping). Also at 1400 first sample: sidebar floating + card 1024-1384 vs sheet 348-1053 (29 px overlap). Path 1240->1600 or fresh 1600 land in the stable good state C (both floating, sheet 392-1208, card 1224, gap 16). Cause: useMarginFit judges each side with only its own docked room freed but App applies both flips together. In A, left (196 measured) says dock, right (freed aside) says card -> B. In B, left freed 257+135=392 says float, right measured 257 < 312 says no card -> A. Repeat. The comment 'the fit holds in the state it produces' is false when both sides flip at once. Fix idea: judge the right side in the state the left decision produces (or vice versa / freeze one side per measure, hysteresis), then add a spec: page view 100%, 940 open Research, 1400 then 1600, sample several frames: state steady and card never intersects .editor-paper. Native WebKit branch only unit-tested; left to V's native screens.

REJECT: floating sidebar overlaps the text column in continuous view at 125/150% zoom, and the fit flaps. Reviewer sweep (fresh vite build, port 1925, 800 high, floating on, widths 940..1600 up then down; log node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui6-rev-t229/sweep.log): cont150 1080 floating, sidebar 16-260 vs .writing-surface left 146 (114 px overlap); cont150 1240 sidebar 0-270 vs col 152; cont150 1040 sidebar right 270 vs col 146; cont150 1000 sidebar 16-220 vs col 146. cont125 flaps (is-floating differs between up and down sweeps at 1040/1060/1080/1100/1240). Cause: src/components/floating.ts columnMaxWidth (~line 60) mixes units: getComputedStyle(paper).maxWidth is the CSS 816px (unzoomed), but .editor-paper carries CSS zoom = layout.zoom/100 in continuous view (Writer.tsx:969), so rect widths are drawn px; at 125/150% maxWidth comes out far too small, grow=0, and freedMargins counts the whole docked width as margin -> floats -> paper widens to 816*zoom -> no margin -> falls back -> repeat. Fix: express maxWidth in drawn px (cssMax * totalZoom(paper) minus the drawn paper-column difference; under reportsUnzoomedRects scale the rect widths by zoom too), then add a floating.spec case: continuous view at 125% and 150%, sweep 1000-1240 both directions, expectClear on .writing-surface whenever is-floating and same is-floating state up vs down. Everything else checked OK: fail-first log real (4 T5 cases fail on wave-5 build); vitest 7/7; full floating.spec 33/33; cont/page 100%, cont75, page75, page125 never overlap, no flapping, gap exactly 16 at tight fits (cont 1080/1100, page75 1060-1100); card sweeps no card/column overlap; page view 1100 panel -> widen 1600 shows card without click; toast with card open right 1208 < card left 1224; drawnEdges/zoom probe intact; narrow-fallback spec assertions unchanged (1100->1040), 1100 spec matches owner ruling.
